tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to drive, lead, guide, conduct
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to drive, lead on, drive away, drive off
1a2) to behave itself (fig.) (of heart)
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to drive away, lead off
1b2) to lead on, guide, guide on
1b3) to cause to drive

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
strongs_1890.kjv_def: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).
